reviewedTree.hashAlgorithm: sha256(concat(sorted relativePath + NUL + sha256(original bytes) + LF))

methodology: Compared complete repository trees from both the prior ingestion snapshot and the latest successful observed source HEAD, covering all changes including older records regardless of modified timestamps.
Read and JSON-parsed all Reviewed files; deterministic fail-closed import reconciles eligible, outside-window, unsupported-ecosystem and failed denominators.
Primary maintainer review covers changed eligible records, not every maintainer source in the entire corpus. Failed API requests and successful HTML fallback are distinguished.

Publication contains allowlisted public structured database fields, content hashes and independent observations, not entire descriptions or proof-of-concept code. No code from advisory sources was executed.
limitations: Full specified Reviewed source coverage is not global vulnerability coverage.
CISA KEV and actual exploitation require separate evidence; publication of an advisory is not evidence of a corporate incident.
